name: Accounts-Payable Clerk
summary: A company employee who receives and processes incoming vendor documents -- invoices, purchase orders, receipts.
description: The first human touchpoint for a document entering the company's document-approval workflow. Submits a received document to doc-approval.analyze to have its type, party, and amount automatically extracted and confidence-scored, so a well-formed, strongly-signaled document can move straight to approval routing without manual re-keying, while a low-confidence or ambiguous document is flagged for the clerk's own manual review before it goes any further. Does not make the final approve/reject decision -- that's the next role in the workflow.

distinguished_from.how: Handles the initial intake and automated analysis of a document; does not make the approve/escalate decision. The approvals manager is a separate, downstream role in the same workflow that reviews what the clerk's tooling already analyzed.
Processes vendor documents (invoices, purchase orders), not meeting transcripts -- a different internal workflow and a different capability entirely.
